## 6ac8de750dbd

**Issue: a nominal large blue shape can be fragmented into many disconnected objects, while `self_check` accepts it.**

Reproducer: `seed=1`, `sample_index=0`, `difficulty=hard`; `self_check` returns no errors.

```text
00000000000
00000000000
00101010000
00000000000
00100010700
00000000000
00000000000
00000000000
00000000000
10000000006
11000000000
```

The scene contains 6 four-connected blue components with sizes `[3, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]`, not the two blue objects described by the generator summary. Five isolated blue cells are visually disconnected from the 3-cell L-shaped component. This undermines the intended “choose the largest of two shapes” concept and enables trivial component-count/isolated-cell shortcuts. The validator should require exactly two connected blue components and verify that each sampled shape is connected before placement. Evidence: `checks/audit/6ac8de750dbd_fragmented_blue_objects.json`.
